name: Hollow Body Hold
summary: An isometric core hold with the lower back pressed down, a foundation for gymnastics and calisthenics.
setup: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift shoulders and legs, keeping legs bent to make it easier.
execution: Raise your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Extend your arms overhead and legs straight if you can keep the back flat.
Hold for the time, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Lower back lifting: bend the knees or raise the legs higher.
Neck strain: keep chin slightly tucked.
Going too long: stop when form fails.
